claim: Touchstone environment 29bedb2b6722 is Excel 16.0.20527 on GOVERT-OMEN under the Windows user culture en-ZA, whose Excel International separators are "." and " ".
evidence: docs/research/text-date-coercion-2026-11-12.md records env_id 29bedb2b6722 as Excel build 20527 on GOVERT-OMEN, reading DATEVALUE year-first (04/02/01 = 38018, 4/2/2001 = #VALUE!), the en-ZA short-date order.

The catalogue capture worker on the same machine and Excel build (file version 16.0.20527.20088; the Touchstone environment record gives 16.0.20527.20150, same CPU and OS build, in touchstone_environment) recorded the Windows user culture and Application.International readings in catalogue_capture (crates/calc-func/tests/captures/cfunc_m3_2/oracle.capture.json); the user culture is a Windows setting that an Excel update does not change.

Every DOLLAR answer of this environment that holds a digit starts with the Rand sign R (the en-ZA currency), after a minus for negatives; grouped answers use U+0020, the International thousands separator, although Application.ThousandsSeparator (calculation_settings) reported U+00A0.
defined_names_evidence: OwnedExcel.cs Setup makes the scratch book by Workbooks.Add (a new workbook holds no defined name or table), and the fingerprint compared with the baseline after every batch counts its visible names (VisibleNames; Excel's hidden _xlfn.* future-function names aside), so a batch that left a name would have recycled the instance.
cell_layout_evidence: tools/excel-service/engines/excel/Program.cs (the bulk path, identical in every version from 03be1c0f of 2026-11-09 to 21920da5 of 2026-11-13, around the 2026-11-12 12:17-12:30 UTC captures): call i of a batch has its formula in column A of row i of sheet S and its arguments as cells from column B of that row (Formula: RC[k+1]; Rng(sheet, 1, 2, totalRows, maxCols).Value2), an error argument entered as its error formula (Formula2R1C1 "=#N/A"); OwnedExcel.cs Setup names the sheets S, A, Q in that order. The row depends on the batch and is not recorded.
addins_evidence: The environment record (touchstone_environment, whose JSON env_id hashes) lists addins_installed [] and com_addins_connected [VS15ExcelAdaptor], the Visual Studio design-time adaptor, which adds no worksheet function.

The worker (tools/excel-service/engines/excel/OwnedExcel.cs Setup, unchanged since fdcc4472 of 2026-11-08, before the 2026-11-12 captures) refuses an Excel instance with any AddIns2 entry open or any registered XLL function, and opens no workbook besides its scratch book (sheets S, A, Q).
